new_items.title: FDA Approves Once-Weekly Generic Hormone Therapy Patch for Women
new_items.summary: Today, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration approved the first generic of Climara Pro (estradiol and levonorgestrel transdermal system, 0.045 mg per day/0.015 mg), a transdermal hormone therapy patch for women with an intact uterus applied once a week.
